outputs.explanation: Panel A is a schematic diagram of the experimental pipeline, not a plot showing averaged data.
Panel B shows representative fluorescence, H&E, and bright-field micrograph/photographic images; it is not a plot presenting averaged data.
Panel C is a bar chart of lactate concentration with mean and 95% CI, and individual data points (dots) for each region are overlaid for Normal lung, LUAD, and LUSC groups.
Panel D is a bar chart of lactate concentration with mean and 95% CI, and individual data points (dots) are overlaid for High pH and Low pH groups.
Panel E is a schematic illustration of the immunosuppressive tumor microenvironment model, not a data plot.
